response.text: Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from the controller confirmation of whether personal data about them are being processed and, if so, access to those personal data and information about the processing (for example purposes, recipients, retention period, and the existence of automated decision‑making). It also entitles the data subject to receive a copy of the personal data and the additional details listed in Article 15, subject to certain restrictions to protect the rights and freedoms of others. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1521391131953&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))
